mapper.select: SELECT a.shop_id, ANY_VALUE(a.shop_name) as shop_name from cere_platform_shop a LEFT JOIN cere_shop_order b ON a.shop_id = b.shop_id and b.state in(1, 2, 3, 4) where YEARWEEK(date_format(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')) = YEARWEEK(now()) GROUP BY a.shop_id ORDER BY SUM(b.price) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ANY_VALUE(a.product_id) as product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.product_name) as product_name, ANY_VALUE(b.price) as original_price, ANY_VALUE(b.price) as price, ANY_VALUE(IF(f.image IS NULL, e.product_image, f.image)) as image, c.sku_id from cere_shop_product a LEFT JOIN cere_product_sku b ON a.product_id = b.product_id LEFT JOIN cere_order_product c ON b.sku_id = c.sku_id LEFT JOIN cere_shop_order d ON c.order_id = d.order_id and d.state in(1, 2, 3, 4) LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.product_image) as product_image from cere_product_image a, cere_shop_product b where a.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id) e ON a.product_id = e.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.sku_id, ANY_VALUE(a.image) as image from cere_sku_name a, cere_product_sku b where a.sku_id = b.sku_id GROUP BY a.sku_id) f ON c.sku_id = f.sku_id where a.shop_id = #{shopId} and a.shelve_state = 1 GROUP BY c.sku_id ORDER BY SUM(c.number) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ANY_VALUE(a.product_id) as product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.product_name) as product_name, ANY_VALUE(IFNULL(f.image, e.product_image)) as image, c.sku_id, ANY_VALUE(b.price) as original_price, ANY_VALUE(b.price) as price, 0 as activityType from cere_shop_product a LEFT JOIN cere_product_sku b ON a.product_id = b.product_id LEFT JOIN cere_order_product c ON b.sku_id = c.sku_id LEFT JOIN cere_shop_order d ON c.order_id = d.order_id and d.state in(1, 2, 3, 4) LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.product_image) as product_image from cere_product_image a, cere_shop_product b where a.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id) e ON a.product_id = e.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.sku_id, ANY_VALUE(a.image) as image from cere_sku_name a, cere_product_sku b where a.sku_id = b.sku_id GROUP BY a.sku_id) f ON c.sku_id = f.sku_id where a.shelve_state = 1 GROUP BY c.sku_id ORDER BY SUM(c.number) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) users, ANY_VALUE(a.product_id) as product_id from (SELECT ANY_VALUE(a.order_id) as order_id, ANY_VALUE(a.product_id) as product_id, b.buyer_user_id FROM cere_order_product a, cere_shop_order b where a.order_id = b.order_id and a.product_id = #{productId} and b.payment_state = 1 GROUP BY b.buyer_user_id) a

SELECT ANY_VALUE(a.shop_id) as shop_id, ANY_VALUE(d.shop_name) as shop_name, a.product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.product_name) as product_name, ANY_VALUE(c.product_image) as image, ANY_VALUE(b.sku_id) as sku_id, ANY_VALUE(ifnull(f.number, 0) + a.fictitious_number) as number, ANY_VALUE(a.product_brief) as product_brief, ANY_VALUE(b.original_price) as original_price, ANY_VALUE(b.price) as price, 0 as activityType from cere_shop_product a LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.price) as price, ANY_VALUE(a.sku_id) as sku_id, ANY_VALUE(a.price) as original_price from cere_product_sku a, cere_shop_product b where a.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id) b ON a.product_id = b.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.product_image) as product_image from cere_product_image a, cere_shop_product b where a.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id) c ON a.product_id = c.product_id LEFT JOIN cere_platform_shop d ON a.shop_id = d.shop_id LEFT JOIN cere_product_classify e ON a.classify_id = e.classify_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(a.number) number, a.sku_id, ANY_VALUE(a.order_id) as order_id from cere_order_product a, cere_shop_order b where a.order_id = b.order_id and b.state in(2, 3, 4) GROUP BY sku_id) f ON b.sku_id = f.sku_id where a.shop_id = #{shopId} and a.shelve_state = 1 and d.state = 1 GROUP BY a.product_id ORDER BY a.update_time DESC, a.create_time DESC

SELECT a.shop_id,a.shop_name,a.shop_logo,IF(SUM(c.number) IS NULL,0,SUM(c.number)) number from cere_platform_shop a LEFT JOIN cere_shop_order b ON b.shop_id = a.shop_id LEFT JOIN cere_order_product c ON c.order_id = b.order_id and b.state IN(2,3,4) where a.shop_id=#{shopId}

SELECT IF(SUM(a.number) IS NULL, ANY_VALUE(c.sale_number), SUM(a.number) + ANY_VALUE(c.sale_number)) FROM cere_order_product a JOIN (select ifnull(sum(fictitious_number), 0) as sale_number from cere_shop_product where shop_id = #{shopId}) c LEFT JOIN cere_shop_order b ON a.order_id = b.order_id where b.shop_id = #{shopId} and b.state in(2, 3, 4)

SELECT shop_group_id as classify_id, group_name as classify_name from cere_shop_group s where shop_id = #{shopId} AND exists (SELECT product_id FROM cere_shop_product p WHERE p.shop_group_id = s.shop_group_id AND shelve_state = 1 limit 1)
SELECT shop_id,banner_style,banner_image,banner_url FROM cere_shop_banner where shop_id=#{shopId} and state=1

SELECT a.shop_id, ANY_VALUE(a.shop_name) as shop_name, ANY_VALUE(a.shop_brief) as shop_brief, ANY_VALUE(a.shop_adress) as shop_adress, ANY_VALUE(a.shop_logo) as shop_logo, ANY_VALUE(IF(c.price IS NULL,0,c.price)) as price, ANY_VALUE(IF(f.number IS NULL,0,f.number)) as number, count(distinct b.classify_id) as productClassifyCount FROM cere_platform_shop a LEFT JOIN cere_shop_product b ON a.shop_id=b.shop_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.product_id, ANY_VALUE(a.price) as price, ANY_VALUE(a.sku_id) as sku_id, ANY_VALUE(a.price) as original_price from cere_product_sku a, cere_shop_product b where a.product_id=b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id) c ON b.product_id=c.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(a.number) number, a.sku_id, ANY_VALUE(a.order_id) as order_id from cere_order_product a, cere_shop_order b where a.order_id=b.order_id and b.state in(2,3,4) GROUP BY sku_id) f ON c.sku_id=f.sku_id where a.check_state=1 and a.state=1 and f.number > 0
and a.shop_name like concat('%',#{search},'%')
and price>=#{minMoney}
and price<=#{maxMoney}
GROUP BY a.shop_id ORDER BY
price,
price DESC,
number,
number DESC,
a.update_time DESC,a.create_time DESC
